_about: The ONLY geometry primitives we can build. The CAD tool offers a fixed block library and we can place nothing else, so every chamber and channel in chip/*.json must map to a block id below. 'Multilayer' blocks are deliberately absent: we print a SINGLE fluidic layer, so no block that needs a second layer, a via or a crossing is usable. tools/check_chip_spec.py enforces this list, the single-layer rule and the build envelope.

envelope.note: Resin 3D printing plus hot embossing, one fluidic layer, 30 x 20 mm build area.

fabrication_floors.note: From the fabrication review. Print open and seal with film rather than printing an enclosed channel below 0.5 mm.

basic.serpentine_channel: Folded run: length (resistance or residence time) in a small area.
basic.port: Through-hole to tubing. The only fluid inlet/outlet.
basic.curved_y_junction: Y with swept arms, lower shear than a sharp Y.
basic.trap_chamber: Chamber with retention features at its outlet.
basic.flow_focusing_funnel: Tapered funnel into a narrow throat.
basic.flow_divider: Splits a stream into set fractions.

advanced.pillar_array: Regular pillars: filtration, support, or holding a lid flat.
advanced.pillar_funnel_trap: Funnel into a pillar gap; traps a particle at the throat.
advanced.dld_array: Deterministic lateral displacement: sorts by size continuously.
advanced.lock_and_shift_trap: Captures then releases on flow reversal.
advanced.metering_trap: Captures a FIXED VOLUME. The block for metered splitting.
advanced.round_sorting_junction: Size/inertia sorting at a round junction.
advanced.centipede_channel: Many short side branches off a spine.
advanced.herringbone_mixer: Chevron grooves; chaotic advection mixing at low Re.
advanced.spiral_channel: Archimedean spiral; inertial focusing or long path.
advanced.phase_guide: Capillary pinning ridge; stops a liquid front at a defined line.
advanced.wagon_wheel_port: Port with radial spokes; even feed, resists collapse.
advanced.gradient_generator: Tree network producing a concentration gradient.
advanced.angiogenesis: Parallel channels separated by posts, for sprouting assays.
advanced.tesla_valve: Passive flow diode. USELESS BELOW Re 1: diodicity is exactly 1.0 in Stokes flow, so do not use it for rectification at our flow rates.

excluded.multilayer: All 15 multilayer blocks. We print one fluidic layer, so anything needing a second layer, a via, a membrane or a crossing channel is unavailable. This is why no chip may route two channels across each other.

retention._problem: The smallest feature we can print is 200 um IN PLANE. A capsule is 70 um, swelling to 140 um. So no printed in-plane gap can retain a capsule, and every 5-30 um mesh in the old designs is unbuildable. On-chip washing depends on retention, so this decides whether washing works at all.
retention.solution: DEPTH WEIR. The 200 um floor applies to WIDTH, not to z: a crest 240 um tall leaves a 60 um gap under the lid, which retains a 70 um capsule while liquid passes. It is still ONE fluidic layer, because the crest is relief in the same mould or print, exactly like the print-open-and-seal-with-film rule above. Prior art: Harrison/Oleschuk weir bead traps (US 7,312,611).

weir_geometry.rule: gap <= 0.5 x the smallest capsule diameter. Hydrogels extrude through gaps near 0.6 D, so a 100 um gap would pass 70 um capsules.
weir_geometry.untested: No published capture efficiency for weirs retaining particles above 100 um. Run a coupon with 40, 60 and 80 um gaps before committing. z tolerance of +/-20 um is a 33% error on a 60 um gap.

alternatives_ranked: dld_array as a CONTINUOUS WASH rather than retention: at gap 200 um and eps 0.125 the critical diameter is ~105 um, so swollen capsules displace and unswollen ones do not. Needs +/-10 um gap tolerance.

Bought woven nylon mesh insert (5 um and up) clamped in a recessed ledge. The 200 um floor does not apply to a bought part. Use only where retention below 50 um is needed. Adds a manual assembly step.
Sedimentation sump: keep upward velocity below the ~50-210 um/s settling speed, which caps exchange at roughly 6-9 uL/min in a 0.3 mm x 15 mm channel. Works, but slow.
Off-chip centrifuge. Works today but breaks the nothing-off-chip claim.
retention.not_viable: pillar_array and pillar_funnel_trap cannot retain by size exclusion at a 200 um throat. Stagnation-point traps need active feedback and were published for 1-15 um beads.
